Strong emphasis on sub-100ms streamed token latency for interactive completions + nightly/continuous embedding refresh for a ~120M-line monorepo index. Wants model/version pinning + rollouts; cannot tolerate silent quality regressions.

Sales/rep notes: AE Sofia leading; SE Daniel doing tech deep dive. CTO quote: "If completions regress we lose customer trust overnight. Must pin models and have canary fallback."

Security: SOC2 in progress, requires SSO/SAML + KMS integration + audit log exports. Data residency: US only for now.

requirements_summary: Needs two parallel capabilities: 1) Real-time IDE copilot: token-by-token streaming with end-to-end editor latency target <120ms (p90) and p99 guardrails; model pinning + canary rollouts; deterministic inference for reproducing completions. 2) High-throughput background pipelines: continuous embedding refresh for large monorepo (~5M indexing units), target throughput >=50k embeddings/min, support for large-batch throughput, automatic batching and cache reuse. Must support VPC deployment, SSO, audit logs, KMS key integration, and US-only residency.
poc_plan: Week 0: Access & onboarding (token, VPC peering, security contacts)
Week 1: Deploy Dedicated pool with a pinned model (Code-variant) + run synthetic streaming load (250 concurrent editor sessions)
Week 2: Start embedding refresh pipeline against a 500k-file sample; validate batching / throughput; measure cost per 1M embeddings
Week 3: Run simultaneous load (editor streaming + background embedding job); validate isolation, latency SLOs, and fallback path (cheaper quantized model)
technical_constraints: Editor streaming token latency target: p90 <120ms, p99 <250ms
Embedding job cadence: full refresh every 6 hours, delta refresh within 30 minutes
Preferred model variants: CodeLlama-70B-q4 / smaller q4_0 quantized variants; must support pinned versioning and deterministic output
KV cache retention for active sessions; prefer server-side cache to reduce repetitive compute
On-prem/on-air gaps: cannot be air-gapped currently; VPC required for Dedicated
decision_criteria: Meets p99 streaming latency under mixed load
Clear unit economics for nightly embedding runs (cost per 1M embeddings)
Seamless SSO/SAML & KMS integration with audit log export
Ability to pin model versions and do canary/A-B rollouts without service disruption
additional_comments: Risk: if Redwood's Dedicated plan can't guarantee isolation during heavy background indexing, the team will consider a hybrid approach (hosted API for copilot + separate managed cluster for embeddings). Top ask from infra: a test that shows batching recommendations reduce token cost by at least 20% for their workload. Blocker timeline: SSO cert rotation discussion delayed legal sign-off by 2 weeks.
